name: media-pipeline-mcp
description: MCP server for media asset processing with dual-provider image generation (Google Gemini + OpenAI)

scripts.bundle:mcp: esbuild build/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=build/bundle.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:cli: esbuild build/cli.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=build/cli.bundle.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle: npm run build && npm run bundle:mcp && npm run bundle:cli
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add manifest.json package-lock.json ../.claude-plugin/plugin.json ../.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run check:version && npm run bundle && npm run smoke:test && mcpb pack . media-pipeline.mcpb
